title: Mehoni protest over TIA appointments and security-force crackdown
scope: The Reporter reports protests in Mehoni; HRF’s contemporaneous-summary text says a called march was prevented before public participation. Do not extend to Mekelle/Chercher without event-level dating.
organizer: Unknown; neither source names a specific organizer.

state_target.evidence: The Reporter links the protest to administrative appointments and reports the wider demand for elected local representatives.

demands_original: Demand that only elected representatives govern localities, as summarized in the article.
threshold_50_evidence: No count or qualitative estimate establishes 50 simultaneous people.

start_date.summary: The Reporter article dates the Mehoni protests 31 August; HRF report separately describes a public march call for that day.

end_date.summary: Neither source specifies how long protest activity lasted.

location.summary: The report describes the repression in Mehoni; do not extend it to other cited towns.

scope.summary: The Reporter reports fresh protests in Mehoni over appointments. HRF says the called march was prevented before participation; occurrence accounts differ.

organizer.summary: Neither source names a specific organizer.

state_target.summary: Article ties the protest to TIA administrative appointments.

demands.summary: The broader account says demonstrators demanded only elected representatives govern localities.

participants_original.summary: Neither source gives a participant count.

threshold_50_evidence.summary: No attendance estimate or description proves 50 simultaneous participants.

protester_violence.summary: The article reports state force against protesters but no protester violence.

state_response.summary: Article reports blocked roads, physical assault, one death and one injury in the crackdown; HRF describes the march being prevented. No exact crowd-control sequence is specified.

notes: Keep distinct from Maichew Aug29 and the search-only East Wollega cluster. The Reporter article cites HRF, so this is not independent corroboration. Response fields describe the Mehoni account only.
open_questions: Did the demonstration actually occur, given HRF says participation was blocked while The Reporter says protests erupted?
Did at least 50 people attend simultaneously?
What organizer and precise duration are documented?
Are reported one death and one injury directly linked to the protest crackdown, and who caused them?
